s: Who said that the project named Ramapada Sagaram near Polavaram will be built?
x:
Sir Shonthi Venkataramamurthy, one of the distinguished irrigation engineers of Andhra, strongly advocated the construction of a major irrigation project across the Godavari River near Polavaram. He proposed that the project be named "Ramapada Sagaram." His proposal highlighted the enormous irrigation potential of the Godavari River and emphasized that its waters could transform the drought-prone regions of Andhra through irrigation, drinking water supply and hydroelectric generation. Although Sir Arthur Cotton pioneered irrigation development through the construction of the Dowleswaram Anicut, the proposal to build the Polavaram project as Ramapada Sagaram is associated with Sir Shonthi Venkataramamurthy. Later, Dr. K. L. Rao also supported the development of India's river valley projects and interlinking of rivers, but the original proposal carrying the name Ramapada Sagaram is credited to Sir Shonthi Venkataramamurthy.
Hence, the correct answer is

s: Which is the longest canal of commercial importance in Andhra?
x:
The Buckingham Canal is the longest navigation canal on the eastern coast of India and the most important canal of commercial significance in Andhra Pradesh. Constructed during the British period, the canal extends for about 796 km, running parallel to the Coromandel Coast from Andhra Pradesh to Tamil Nadu. It connected several important ports and facilitated the transport of rice, salt, timber, textiles and agricultural produce before the development of railways and highways. In Andhra Pradesh, the canal connected important centres such as Kakinada, Eluru, Machilipatnam and Nellore, making it a vital route for inland water transport. Although the K.C. Canal, Bandar Canal and Eluru Canal are important irrigation canals, they do not possess the same commercial and navigational significance as the Buckingham Canal.
Hence, the correct answer is
Option (4).
